verdict.rationale: Patch cadence is a fair question for an open-source desktop app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no release history, security advisories, or patch-turnaround data. The only changelog items (Jan v0.7.3 Browser MCP, pause/resume downloads) are feature announcements and say nothing about how quickly critical bugs or vulnerabilities get fixed.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how quickly the project ships patches for critical bugs and security vulnerabilities based on its public release history
